Title: Users' browsers hang in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 when editing attack simulation training end user notifications

User impact: Users' browsers hang when editing Microsoft Defender for Office 365 attack simulation training end user notifications.

More info: When the browser hang occurs, the browser hangs indefinitely until the users exits out. This occurs before the user is able to perform the notification edits. 

Current status: We're reviewing HTTP Archive format (HAR) logs captured from an impacted user, in parallel with a screen recording of impact as we work to confirm potential sources of impact. 

Scope of impact: Some users who are utilizing Microsoft Defender for Office 365 users editing attack simulation training end user notifications are impacted. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Friday, August 28, 2026, at 8:30 PM UTC

Title: Users' browsers hang in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 when editing attack simulation training end user notifications

User impact: Users' browsers hang when editing Microsoft Defender for Office 365 attack simulation training end user notifications.

More info: When the browser hang occurs, the browser hangs indefinitely until the users exits out. This occurs before the user is able to perform the notification edits.

Current status: Following our review of the internal reproduction of impact and HAR logs provided by a subset of affected users, we’ve determined that there is a latent code regression that is causing users’ browsers to hang in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 when editing attack simulation training end user notifications and resulting in impact. We’ve developed a code fix to address this issue and anticipate that the deployment progress will begin prior to our next scheduled update. At which point, we aim to provide a remediation timeline. 

Scope of impact: Some users who are utilizing Microsoft Defender for Office 365 users editing attack simulation training end user notifications are impacted. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Start time: Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 2:30 PM UTC
